fnol_text: My name is Valentina Al-Sayed and I live at 523 Larkspur Lane, Ashland, OR 97535. You can reach me on (555) 978-2784 or valentina.alsayed@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 1 May 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00009. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Al-Sayed on (555) 978-2784 to acknowledge the claim. Valentina confirmed the loss date as 1 May 2025.
Site visit to 523 Larkspur Lane. Neighbour Grace Wojcik was present and confirmed the timeline.
Valentina sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
